shared_elements: vertical, tall picture field on rough natural stone
monochrome earth-toned surface with figures reserved against it
elongated, schematic outline figures with small heads on long necks
narrow curved/hooked or handled elements attached to a body
limbs/appendages rendered as thin bent lines
justification: Both are tall, monochrome, weathered stone surfaces bearing extremely schematic figures with small heads on long necks and thin hooked appendages, which gives a faint family resemblance in silhouette vocabulary. But A is a flat two-figure painting in red outline with no registers, while B is a low-relief carved pillar organised into stacked horizontal bands of quadrupeds, birds and serpentine forms, so the technique and compositional logic are entirely unrelated.
